source: read-only preview; no model training or scoring; test not read

partition.method: three seeded speaker-hash groups, before model/threshold selection

usage.model_selection: normal val only for early stopping and best model selection
usage.calibration: normal val only for threshold fitting after model selection
usage.evaluation: mixed held-out val only for development metrics

partition.test_access: separate existing split, explicit opt-in only
limitations: Speaker separation does not prove independent overlapping windows or absence of duplicate text across speakers.
Proxy normality is defined by next-character y, not a semantic anomaly label.

train_input_guard.hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 x, no normalization
train_input_guard.action: exclude exact previously trained x from held-out scoring views; never modify original files
train_input_guard.limitation: Exact-input quarantine does not detect paraphrases, near duplicates or semantic overlap

sampling.method: full requested-split scan with bounded seeded reservoirs per requested role/speaker
sampling.score_access: none; sampling and label bookkeeping only
limitations: Speaker-stratified subsets do not preserve population class prevalence exactly.
No claim of complete cross-speaker exact-text deduplication or IID windows.
